# Edge cases

A paragraph with a [link](https://example.com) and **bold** text that
wraps across two source lines.

```ts
const x = "not a heading, not a checklist item — ``` inside stays raw too";
```

> A blockquote line, untouched.
> A second blockquote line.

* A star-bulleted item, not a dash.
+ A plus-bulleted item.

- [ ] Todo item
- [x] Done item
- [~] In-progress item
  - [ ] A nested todo, indented two spaces

| a | b\|escaped | c |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 2 | 3 |
